title: Substitution Method — Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
hook: Let's explore Substitution Method from the chapter on Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Substitution Method Express one variable in terms of the other from one equation, substitute into the second equation to get a single variable equation, then solve. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Step 1: From one equation, express y in terms of x (or vice versa)
💡 Step 2: Substitute this expression into the other equation
💡 Step 3: Solve the single-variable equation
💡 Step 4: Substitute back to find the other variable
